explanation_short: The chart compares the performance of different machine learning models for predicting hydrogen production (HPR). KNN achieved the best performance with an R2 score of 0.81717 and an MSE of 0.012810.
explanation_full: This chart presents a comparison of various machine learning models' performance in predicting hydrogen production (HPR) based on their R2 score and Mean Squared Error (MSE).  The KNN model demonstrated the highest performance with an R2 score of 0.81717, indicating a strong correlation between predicted and actual HPR values. It also achieved the lowest MSE of 0.012810, signifying greater accuracy in its predictions compared to other models like SVM, DT, RF, and XGBoost.
